subject: Following up on your concerns
text:
Thanks for letting me know where you were frustrated. I checked the notes from our first call, and I did understand the timeline as three visits per month, not weekly check-ins.

I agree the wording in the summary could have been clearer. Going forward, I’ll confirm any schedule changes in writing before they begin.

If weekly visits are what your household actually needs, I can quote that as a separate arrangement. For now, I’ll keep the current plan unless you ask me to change it.
